responsibility: Implements higher-level x86 backend feature support that is not basic instruction selection: notably out-of-line prologue/epilogue stub layout management and x86 function multiversioning dispatch generation. It defines the xlogue_layout data and algorithms that describe which callee-saved registers can be handled by save/restore stubs, and it builds ifunc-based dispatcher and resolver functions for target-clone/versioned functions, wiring cgraph version chains into runtime CPU-based dispatch bodies.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-features.h, which declares the xlogue_layout/scalar_chain machinery and related interfaces, this file implements that feature-support logic, including out-of-line save/restore stub layout handling and generation of x86 function multiversioning dispatchers and resolvers.
